# Outbound — Persona 2: Agency Owners (white-label / overflow)

Who: small agency owners (2–15 people) drowning in delivery: missed deadlines,
"we don't do landing pages" gaps, or hiring posts for junior devs.
Find them: agency directories, X agency owners, LinkedIn "hiring web designer"
posts, Slack communities (#freelance, #agency channels).

Angle: you are overflow capacity + a productized offer they can resell — NOT a
competitor. Never pitch their clients; pitch the owner.

## Personalization variables (fill ALL before sending — ~3 min research)

- `[FirstName]` — owner's first name
- `[Agency]` — agency name
- `[SpecificObservation]` — ONE concrete signal (e.g. "your careers page lists a junior dev role open 3 months" / "your portfolio shows no landing-page work since 2024")
- `[TheirOffer]` — their core service in their words
- `[OverflowAngle]` — the gap you'd fill (e.g. "landing-page overflow at fixed cost you can mark up")
- `[DayOption]` — two specific days

## Anti-spam rules (all 4 templates)

1. Pitch the owner, never their clients. Never contact a prospect's client list.
2. First two lines must contain `[SpecificObservation]`.
3. One follow-up max, 4–5 business days later, then drop.
4. Every message includes an easy out. Max 10 new prospects/day. No automation.
5. Only cite numbers you measured. Never claim team size or clients you don't have.

---

## 2A. Email — the overflow partner pitch

Subject: overflow landing pages for `[Agency]`?

> Hi `[FirstName]`,
>
> Noticed `[SpecificObservation]` — looks like `[TheirOffer]` is selling faster
> than delivery can keep up.
>
> I'm a solo builder studios use for `[OverflowAngle]`: fixed quote upfront, 2
> revision rounds, handoff docs included, 14-day bug window. You mark it up,
> client never needs to know I exist (white-label) — or I'm credited, your call.
>
> Quick way to test me: one $5 idea call where I scope a real page from your
> backlog and quote it fixed. Open `[DayOption]`?
>
> If capacity's fine, say the word and I'll close this out — one check-in max.
>
> — `[YourName]`, `[Studio]` · `[portfolio/GitHub link]`

## 2B. LinkedIn DM — peer-to-peer (note on connect, pitch only after accept)

> Hi `[FirstName]` — I work with small agencies as white-label build capacity.
> Saw `[SpecificObservation]`, so figured `[OverflowAngle]` might help.
>
> Model: you sell it, I build it fixed-price with handoff docs, you keep the
> margin. Want to test with one $5 scoping call on a real backlog item — `[DayOption]`?
> Totally fine if timing's off, just say so.

## 2C. Discord/Slack DM — only in agency/freelancer servers where promo is allowed, and only after contributing visibly

> hey `[FirstName]` — saw your post about `[SpecificObservation]` in here.
>
> I'm a solo dev who does white-label overflow for agencies (`[OverflowAngle]`,
> fixed quotes, handoff docs). If your backlog ever needs an extra pair of
> hands without a hire, happy to scope one page on a $5 call so you can see
> how I work. No pressure — mostly wanted to say your `[TheirOffer]` positioning
> is sharp.

## 2D. Follow-up (ONE, 4–5 business days later)

Subject: Re: overflow landing pages for `[Agency]`?

> Hi `[FirstName]` — one check-in: is overflow help for `[Agency]` worth a
> 60-min $5 scoping call, or should I close this out?
>
> Either way's fine. If next-quarter planning changes things, happy to
> reconnect then.
>
> — `[YourName]`

(No second follow-up. Log outcome, move on.)
